name: Fairness Benchmark for AI-Generated Face Detection
description: The task involves detecting AI-generated faces from real ones while ensuring fairness across demographic groups, using the AI-Face dataset, which includes real and AI-generated faces annotated with demographic attributes such as skin tone, gender, and age.

cr:input.name: AI-Face Dataset
cr:input.description: A million-scale dataset containing 400,885 real face images and 1,245,660 AI-generated face images. The dataset includes demographic annotations (skin tone, gender, age) and images generated by 37 methods, including Deepfake Videos, GANs, and Diffusion Models. Example sources include FFHQ, IMDB-WIKI, FF++, DFDC, and Celeb-DF-v2.

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: The output consists of predictions indicating whether a face is real or AI-generated, along with fairness metrics across demographic groups (skin tone, gender, age).

field.name: is_ai_generated
field.description: Indicates whether the face is AI-generated (true) or real (false). Example values: true, false.

field.name: skin_tone
field.description: Predicted skin tone based on the Monk Skin Tone scale (1-10). Example values: 1, 5, 10.

field.name: gender
field.description: Predicted gender of the face. Example values: Male, Female.

field.name: age_group
field.description: Predicted age group of the face. Example values: Child, Youth, Adult, Middle-age Adult, Senior.

cr:evaluation.primaryMetric: [FILL IN THE BLANK: primary evaluation metric]
metrics: [FILL IN THE BLANK: list of all evaluation metrics mentioned in the paper]
cr:evaluation.higherIsBetter: [FILL IN THE BLANK: true or false]
cr:evaluation.notes: [FILL IN THE BLANK: any special computation details for the metrics]
